result: I’d make the human default be to experience other people as fully real—not as categories, threats, obstacles, or abstractions. Not forced empathy or sentimentality: just an inability to comfortably write someone off once you’ve seen them. A lot of the world’s cruelty runs through that small act of making other people unreal.
